title: Te Rerenga Mokemoke
intro: I roto i ngā pukapuka o te manaakitanga atua, kei reira tētahi wairua parakore e kore e rite, kua wehea mai i ō rātou iwi ki te rapu i te mokemoke i te huarahi tapu. Kāore rātou i mōhio ka puta mai i tēnei mokemoke he tohu mō ngā ao katoa, he whakamātautau whakapono ka kōrerotia mō ake tonu atu.
clues: I whakatapua ahau ki tētahi oranga mahi pononga i mua i tōku whānautanga.
I tukuna ahau ki raro i te mana tiaki o tētahi poropiti rangatira.
I tautokona ahau e ngā kai a Allah, ā, i miharo taku kaitiaki.
I mawehe atu ahau i tōku whānau ki tētahi wāhi ki te rawhiti.
I puta mai tētahi anahera ki ahau i roto i te āhua o tētahi tangata tino tika, me te kawe mai i te rongo mō tētahi tama parakore.
I taku hokinga mai me taku pēpi hou, ka whakapae mai tōku iwi ki ahau, engari i kōrero te pēpi hei tiaki i ahau.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Meri (Mēri)
Āhia (te wahine a Parao)
Hajar (whaea o Ismail)
Hera (wahine a Ibrahim)
Te whaea o Musa

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te haputanga merekara me te whānautanga o te tama
Te maka ki roto i te ahi
Te horomia e te ika nui
Te hanga i tētahi āka nui
Te whiti i te moana
trial.answer: Te haputanga merekara me te whānautanga o te tama

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: He wāhi motuhake ki te rawhiti
Te rakau e mura ana
Te Moana Whero
Te kohatu i pupū mai ai te wai
Te tohorā
location.answer: He wāhi motuhake ki te rawhiti

outcome.label: Hua
options: I kōrero te pēpi hei tiaki i te whaea
I wehea te moana
I mātao te ahi, ā, i haumaru hoki
I ruaki te tohorā ki uta
I tau te āraka ki runga i te maunga
outcome.answer: I kōrero te pēpi hei tiaki i te whaea

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
verse: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east. (19:16)
